name: My Fluffy Neighbor
source:
In My Fluffy Neighbor, you've hit rock bottom - fired from your fifth job and facing eviction. Just when all hope seems lost, you inherit a mysterious cottage in the remote village of Oakridge from your estranged grandmother.

But this isn't just any ordinary village - it's entirely populated by anthros who've been living hidden from the human world for generations. As the only human resident, you must navigate this enchanting new community while building relationships with its charming inhabitants.

[From [url=https://invisiblecactus.itch.io/my-fluffy-neighbor]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《我的毛茸茸的邻居》中，你已经跌入谷底——被第五份工作解雇并面临被驱逐。就在所有希望似乎都破灭的时候，你从疏远的祖母那里继承了偏远村庄橡树岭的一座神秘小屋。

但这并不是一个普通的村庄——这里住满了世世代代隐居于人类世界之外的人类。作为唯一的人类居民，你必须探索这个迷人的新社区，同时与迷人的居民建立关系。

[来自[url=https://invisiblecactus.itch.io/my-fluffy-neighbor]itch.io[/url]]
